messages:
maria: Heads up, spotted a flaky repro in the Next.js + LangChain sample app. Long streaming calls in the notebook abort midway and the cell keeps retrying forever.
kevin: is this the sample that uses ephemeral demo keys in the README?
maria: yes. Steps: clone sample, pip install, set REDWOOD_DEMO_KEY to the short-lived token we hand out for workshop attendees, run summary cell that streams ~2m. After ~65s the stream dies with 401 and the client retries; then we get 429s and the UI never surfaces a clear auth error 10s backoffs loop.
tara: hmm that matches an SDK behavior where mid-stream auth errors get retried instead of propagated. Which Python SDK version?
maria: redwood-sdk 0.8.1 pinned in requirements.txt. Works in small runs (<30s) but fails for longer streams.
kevin: JS had a fix to treat 401 during active SSE as terminal. Python parity gap then.
sdk-bot: ISSUE-124 opened to track python-stream-401 handling. Assigned to @kevin.
kevin: thanks. Short-term fix for the sample: change README to recommend using REDWOOD_LOCAL_TOKEN (longer TTL) for interactive notebooks and add a pre-check cell that calls /v1/tokens/validate to warn if TTL < 120s. I'll send a tiny PR.
maria: that will help workshop folks. Long-term we should change the Python SDK default retry policy: do not retry on 401 for in-flight streaming requests. Also add an SDK telemetry event when retries are suppressed so we can observe frequency.
tara: agree. Also add an eval in our harness that simulates an auth-expiry mid-stream and asserts the SDK surfaces an explicit auth error instead of retry loops. I can add that to the nightly regression suite.
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-starters/pull/202 created. It includes: README note, preflight TTL cell, and bumps sdk to 0.8.2-rc. I also updated the sample to catch StreamClosedError and raise AuthenticationError.
ci-bot: preview deploy: https://preview.redwood.dev/devex-starters/pr-202 ready.
maria: validated locally with the patched starter and a 90s stream, reproducer now fails-fast with "Auth expired during stream" and the notebook cell shows a clear message + link to how to refresh tokens. Much better UX.
kevin: next steps: SDK team to backport the behavior from the rc to stable, add metrics, and coordinate a patch release. QA to add the harness test.
tara: adding notes to the onboarding guide to highlight recommended token lifetimes for different environments (notebook vs CI vs demo infra).
maria: thanks all! leaving a note in the sample README about how to generate a longer-lived dev token for local demos.
